scenes.title: Only the Neighbour Next Door
scenes.summary: The Tuesday-night knock turns out to be a neighbour returning a misdelivered city envelope confirming Wednesday's three-o'clock visit.

scenes.title: General in an Apron
scenes.summary: At 6:00 AM Wednesday, Miriam sits with her ankle on pillows directing Moritz's bread kneading and Klara's lemon curd like a cheerful general.

scenes.title: Carrots by the Millimetre
scenes.summary: Lukas chops vegetables with architectural precision for the lentil soup while Moritz and Miriam tease him affectionately.

scenes.title: Setting Room Nine
scenes.summary: At half past two on Wednesday, Klara, Helga, and Werner lay white linen cloths, stoneware cups, and small lemon branches on the tables in Room 9.

scenes.title: Put the Speech Away
scenes.summary: At 2:55 PM, Martin nervously recites a stiff five-page history speech until Klara and Werner convince him to simply welcome the visitor naturally.

scenes.title: The Heritage Stamp
scenes.summary: After inspecting the open gate, sunlit café tables, lending books, and hot tea, the heritage clerk signs the protection form—and asks Helga to play.

scenes.title: Toast in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: Listening to Helga's piano waltz from the kitchen doorway, Miriam, Lukas, and Moritz clink teacups to celebrate passing the review.

scenes.title: The Tune at the Gate
scenes.summary: At the courtyard gate, Martin, Klara, and Helga learn the passerby was the violinist neighbor who used to play Friday duets with Martin's aunt thirty years ago—and he promises to return Friday at six!
